title: LED strip (WS2812 / NeoPixel)
summary: Drive WS2812B / SK6812 RGB LED strips with exact timing from the FPGA: up to 1024 LEDs, brightness and colour order in hardware.
wiring: through a 74AHCT125 level shifter (5 V strips), or a 330 ohm resistor for a short test
strip GND and the 5 V supply's GND
about 60 mA per LED at full white
parts: WS2812B or SK6812 LED strip / ring
5 V power supply (1 A per 16 LEDs at full white)
1000 uF capacitor across the strip supply
tested: the self-test passed 13 of 13 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
